description: She wears a deep green floor-length gown with a low square neckline, elbow-length sleeves and pale linen sleeve underlayers. Gold knotwork woven borders decorate the neckline, center front, cuffs and hem. A narrow woven belt has a round buckle, and a patterned fringed green shawl rests around her forearms. A light underdress appears at the low center skirt opening, with brown closed shoes beneath the hem. Her head is bare.
